name: H2. Physician workload and care-quality scorecard
rawText:
# Do you know how effectively your physicians manage their workload and patient care?
#  - Which physicians handle the highest number of completed visits?
#  - How many unique patients does each physician serve?
#  - How much time do physicians spend with patients on average?
#  - Which physicians generate the highest total charges?
#  - What percentage of laboratory results are abnormal for each physician's patients?
#  - Which physicians manage high patient volumes while maintaining better laboratory outcomes?
#  - How does physician workload and care quality compare across departments and clinic locations?
#  - Are there physicians with no completed visits who may need further operational attention?
# ____________________________________________________________

PhysicianScorecard is Doctors:
    FirstName + < > + LastName Physician,
    Department.Name Department,
    Location.City ClinicCity,
    Examinations.CountIf(Status = <Completed>) VisitCount,
    Examinations.CountIf(distinct UserId, Status = <Completed>) PatientCount,
    Examinations.AvgIf(DurationMinutes, Status = <Completed>).Round(2) AverageVisitMinutes,
    Examinations.SumIf(Charge, Status = <Completed>) Charges,
    (100 * Examinations.SumIf(LabResults.CountIf(IsAbnormal = <True>), Status = <Completed>)
        / NullIf(Examinations.SumIf(LabResults.Count(Id), Status = <Completed>), 0)).Round(2) AbnormalLabPercent
  Where Department.Name In <Primary Care, Specialty Care, Emergency Medicine>
  Order VisitCount DESC, Charges DESC
  Take 10
id: Health 2. Physician workload and care-quality scorecard
